title: EventLine
description:
One line of a run's event log, `{jsonl: <file>}`: UTF-8 JSON Lines,
appended to and never rewritten. `t` and `node` are required, plus
`status` or `note`.

agent.description: The agent that made it, by id.

attempt.description:
The attempt it belongs to. A busy event with the same attempt as the
one before continues it.

note.description: A note on it, such as why a dispatch was refused.

status.description: Its new status, in the workflow's words.

t.description: When it happened, RFC 3339, such as `2026-11-01T14:02:07.120Z`.
